verdict.rationale: Pika's own docs claim it 'scores any clip to picture' with music, ambience and foley matched to the action. Text-to-SFX, music generation and sound-for-video apps are listed on the same platform that does video creation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the scene-matched scoring works, and detailed documentation of how audio is matched and synced to the clip beyond one-line marketing descriptions.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Scores any clip to picture—music, ambience and foley matched to the action.
Describe the sound and choose a duration to make audio for your video or creative project.
Describe a genre, mood and tempo, add lyrics for vocal tracks, and choose the length your project needs.
Pika brings video, image, and sound creation into one place
